_comment: Reviewed terms of licenses with no standard text in spdx-standard-licenses.json. A package file covers such a license only when it carries these terms whole (carriesWholeStandardText). The texts come from SPDX license-list-data (text/<id>.txt); for bzip2-1.0.6 the sentence before the conditions and the signature after the disclaimer name the program's holder and version and are left out, as the shipped variants change them. For FSFULLR, curl and SAX-PD-2.0 the title, the copyright lines and the signature are left out, as libssh2 ships these licenses in its REUSE folder (libssh2/LICENSES) with other holders and years; a REUSE file covers its identifier only when it carries these terms whole, never by its file name alone.

_notices: A copyright notice that may continue on its next line (no holder after the years, an open parenthesis, a trailing comma, and, of or by) is never joined by a guess: the generation fails unless the notice is reviewed here with every line it continues on (following), each matched upstream, and the whole notice read at its source. A reviewed line that is an example value in documentation, not anyone's notice, is marked "example": true with an empty notice, and gives no attribution. A reviewed line that cites a work the code refers to (a book, a paper), not a notice of the code, is marked with "citation" (the package, version and file it was reviewed in) and an empty notice, and gives no attribution there; the same lines in another package or file are read as a notice.
